resources.string: Rootless fake ClientHello, TLS fragmentation, verified ECH and automatic IP fallback. Your real TLS identity stays unchanged. Certificate verification is always enforced while enabled.
Encrypt the real TLS hostname. Fail if ECH is unavailable or rejected; never retry with plaintext SNI.
Leave blank to discover ECH through encrypted DNS on this profile’s network. The visible outer name comes from the server configuration.
Separate entries with spaces, commas or newlines. Your real TLS domain and transport Host remain unchanged.
Try a bounded sample from Cloudflare ranges when needed. Enable only for a Cloudflare-hosted profile.
Record TCP/TLS errors, selected IP, method and ECH acceptance in the connection log.
Compare full VPN requests on the current network. Required ECH is never disabled during testing.
Test sampled addresses through this profile, then choose whether to keep successful addresses.
No tests run yet. Repeat tests on Wi-Fi and mobile separately.
Send a low-TTL decoy, then retransmit the real TLS bytes. Requires kernel support and a suitable TTL. Failure stops the connection; it never silently disables the decoy.
If TLS fails, try a bounded set of lower TTLs on fresh connections. A successful connection does not prove that the decoy reached the DPI.
Test the configured TTL and lower values with the real VPN profile. Keeps required ECH enabled and offers the highest successful tested TTL.
